offences.quote: If AI is used in a manner which has not been permitted by the module leader, then this is a breach of academic integrity.

detection.quote: Detection systems cannot be relied upon to detect use of GenAI accurately or consistently.
The AI Advisory Council recommend that detectors should not be used
Identifying false citations or references within an assignment, possibly as a result of AI hallucinations

Where a module leader/nominee has credible grounds to believe that a submitted assessment does not represent a student’s own work or there are other concerns relating to academic integrity, the student can be required to demonstrate authorship directly.

process.quote: a case can be reported to the Academic Integrity Unit as a suspected breach of academic integrity aligning to Level Two: Academic Misconduct or Level Three: Academic Misconduct.
further investigation is required in order to proceed with an academic misconduct investigation.

outcomes.quote: Conversely, inability to explain or extend the work constitutes evidence of a breach of academic integrity and may warrant sanction.
